findings.title: Existing RECREATE exit code silently changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was 4 and is now 3, while the new FEATURE_DISABLED takes the value 4. Any CI script or automation that already branches on exit code 4 to mean 'recreate upgrade required' will now see the feature-disabled case instead, and the recreate case will be reported as 3. The PR does not call this out as a breaking change. If the renumbering is intended, it needs to be explicit in the description and release notes. Otherwise, FEATURE_DISABLED should take a new unused code and the recreate code should stay at 4.

findings.title: setEnabledFeatures overwrites any features already configured on the deployment
findings.body: createInitialDeployment calls kc.getSpec().getFeatureSpec().setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES)). This replaces the whole enabled-features list rather than appending to it. If getTestKeycloakDeployment() or a future base deployment sets other enabled features, they are silently dropped. The List.of result is also immutable, so any later code that tries to add features to it will throw. The fix is to merge into the existing list, or to create a mutable list only when none is present.
